title: Fail-closed GitHub Contents target branch binding

phases.objective: Prevent a missing or stale requested work branch from falling back to the repository default branch during guarded GitHub Contents API writes.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Admin CLI GitHub REST fallback contents PUT
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The mutation executes only against an existing governed non-protected branch at the exact expected head and returns same-cycle branch readback evidence.
steps: Parse the guarded Contents API PUT request.
Require an explicit branch and expected_branch_sha.
Resolve the repository default branch and reject protected/default targets.
Read the requested branch ref and reject missing or stale identity.
Strip governance-only fields before the provider request.
Verify the resulting branch head equals the returned commit SHA.
assertions: Omitted branch input cannot select the default branch.
A missing requested ref cannot fall back to main.
Protected and default branches are rejected.
Concurrent branch movement blocks before mutation.
Successful writes include exact same-cycle branch readback.
No Production, provider, credential, database, migration, deployment, force-push, or external-send authority is introduced.

phases.objective: Observe governed non-protected Contents writes using exact branch identity.
Exercise branch deletion, movement, and malformed provider readback races.
Validate the guard on a disposable repository branch without protected-ref mutation.
Require the guard and server-side main protection before protected delivery.
